purpose: Allow third-party verifiers to run SpatialRuntime's effect-evidence conformance vectors without importing SpatialRuntime code.

input.transport: one JSON object on stdin per test case
input.payload_shape: single-evidence cases contain observation; conflict cases contain observations

output.required_semantics: return verdict fields such as status/reason; extra fields are allowed
output.comparison: the harness requires every expected field/value to be present in the adapter output

nonclaims: The adapter protocol does not standardize a production effect-evidence API.
The adapter protocol exists only to make conformance vectors portable across implementations.
